scope: Public curated names only. Grouped by artist as in the original authority, not a per-world district assignment or a rendered scene.

artists.name: Frawgy
artists.rights_note: Reference/curation only until artist permission or license is recorded

interactions.name: Press
interactions.response: Surface compresses like leaf-gel; nearby dew shifts toward contact point.
interactions.guardrail: Immediate state change; effect follows and can be cancelled.

interactions.name: Drag
interactions.response: Object stretches a soft vine tether and tilts by apparent mass.
interactions.guardrail: No pointer capture loss; tether snaps back cleanly on cancel.

interactions.name: Drop
interactions.response: Lilypad ripple propagates only to nearby relevant objects.
interactions.guardrail: Bounded radius and attention budget.

interactions.name: Delete
interactions.response: Object is gently swallowed by a flower or dissolves into spores; nearby light warms briefly red-coral.
interactions.guardrail: Undo restores from the same flower with no delay.

interactions.name: Add
interactions.response: New item sprouts, unfolds or hatches; environment responds with a faint green glow.
interactions.guardrail: No blocking flourish.

artists.name: Lightweaverart
artists.rights_note: Reference/curation only until artist permission or license is recorded

interactions.name: Hover
interactions.response: A thin iris scan and filament edge reveal depth without brightening all content.
interactions.guardrail: No flashing; preserve contrast.

interactions.name: Press
interactions.response: A sigil ignites under contact, then resolves into the real selected state.
interactions.guardrail: State is authoritative and instantaneous.

interactions.name: Drag
interactions.response: Light fibers braid behind the object according to direction and velocity.
interactions.guardrail: Fibers are renderer-only and never alter layout geometry.

interactions.name: Drop
interactions.response: Filaments tighten into a clean glyph and emit a jeweled click.
interactions.guardrail: Bounded to target region.

interactions.name: Error
interactions.response: Blue glyph fractures into a readable red-magenta diagnostic seam.
interactions.guardrail: No vague glitch effect; error text remains explicit.

artists.name: Dreamrelicc
artists.rights_note: Reference/curation only until artist permission or license is recorded

interactions.name: Hover
interactions.response: A precise halo tracer appears around the active object, with a faint star-ping at valid points of focus.
interactions.guardrail: No blur over text; ring remains thin and high-contrast.

interactions.name: Focus
interactions.response: The active panel is treated like a reliquary, gaining a chapel spotlight and slightly dimmed surroundings.
interactions.guardrail: Dim only nonessential zones; keyboard focus remains explicit.

interactions.name: Add
interactions.response: New items descend as consecrated modules, locking into place with a silver sparkle and soft choir shimmer.
interactions.guardrail: Zero blocking delay; can be disabled in low-effects mode.

interactions.name: Delete
interactions.response: Removed items dissolve into star ash while nearby gold accents briefly warm to ember red.
interactions.guardrail: Undo restores instantly from the same location.

interactions.name: Warning / Conflict
interactions.response: Guardian eyes awaken, a red line passes once through the affected route, and related shrine indicators open.
interactions.guardrail: Single pass only; never global full-screen flashing.

artists.name: Karoline Georges
artists.family: Post-organic rococo metamorphosis / embroidered algorithmic menagerie
artists.rights_note: Reference/curation only until artist permission or license is recorded

interactions.name: Hover
interactions.response: A macro lens reveals stitch direction, material grain and internal layers around the pointed object.
interactions.guardrail: No magnification jump under the cursor; text remains stable and readable.

interactions.name: Press
interactions.response: Textile surfaces compress while porcelain edges hold rigid; nearby gold thread tightens toward the contact point.
interactions.guardrail: State changes immediately; no interaction delay or sticky pointer capture.

interactions.name: Drag
interactions.response: A gold suture tether flexes according to apparent mass while feathers, wings or cloth trail by direction and velocity.
interactions.guardrail: Tether is visual only, fully interruptible and never changes hit testing.

interactions.name: Add
interactions.response: A small cocoon opens, the new item unfolds from mesh and embroidery, then settles into its functional form.
interactions.guardrail: No blocking flourish; low-effects mode uses a single stitched outline.

interactions.name: Delete / Undo
interactions.response: The item molts into a translucent exuvia that remains as the undo anchor; undo rehydrates the original from the same shell.
interactions.guardrail: Undo is immediate and preserves exact state, position and selection.

artists.name: saveroom
artists.rights_note: Reference/curation only until artist permission or license is recorded

interactions.name: Hover / Focus
interactions.response: A thin celestial save-ring aligns beneath the target while a distant map marker and nearby water reflection acknowledge the same focus cause.
interactions.guardrail: No focus delay, no bloom over labels and full keyboard-visible fallback.

interactions.name: Press / Activate
interactions.response: The control depresses like a brass memory-card seal, sends one circular water ripple outward and resolves with a small checkpoint chime.
interactions.guardrail: State changes immediately on activation; audio is optional and the ripple can be interrupted.

interactions.name: Drag / Reorder
interactions.response: The dragged item becomes a tiny navigable island or boat, leaving a wake whose width and curve reflect velocity and direction.
interactions.guardrail: Pointer capture remains authoritative; wake never affects hit testing and cancels cleanly.

interactions.name: Add / Spawn
interactions.response: A new item rises from beneath the water as a mapped island, sheds droplets and lights one citadel window when persistence succeeds.
interactions.guardrail: No blocking reveal; persistence failure prevents the success light and reports truthfully.

interactions.name: Delete / Undo
interactions.response: The item dissolves into blue map pixels and bubbles that flow toward the nearest save shrine; undo reverses the tide and restores exact state and position.
interactions.guardrail: Undo is immediate, deterministic and available before the visual trail finishes.
